FearConsoleConfigurator.Hint: Choose where the Fear Console can be opened.
FearConsoleConfigurator.Label: Configure Fear Console
FearConsoleConfigurator.Name: Fear Console Configurator

XpCurveConfigurator.Hint: Set XP recipient defaults and configure the catch-up and decay curves.
XpCurveConfigurator.Label: Configure XP Curve Console
XpCurveConfigurator.Name: XP Curve Configurator

SceneControls.OpenFearConsole: Open Drowsy’s WFRP4e Toolkit Fear Console.
SceneControls.OpenXpCurveConsole: Open Drowsy’s WFRP4e Toolkit XP Curve Console.

ActorSheetLauncher.Hint: Show a Fear Console launcher in supported WFRP4e actor-sheet headers. Requires a reload.
ActorSheetLauncher.Name: Fear Console: actor-sheet launcher

TokenControlsLauncher.Hint: Show a Fear Console launcher in the Token Controls toolbar. Requires a reload.
TokenControlsLauncher.Name: Fear Console: Token Controls launcher

XpCurveTokenControlsLauncher.Hint: Show an XP Curve Console launcher in the Token Controls toolbar. Requires a reload.
XpCurveTokenControlsLauncher.Name: XP Curve Console: Token Controls launcher

CompanionMultiplier.Hint: The additional multiplier for unassigned, player-owned character actors. 0.5 gives companions half the calculated XP.
CompanionMultiplier.Name: Companion award multiplier

CurveExponent.Hint: Shapes the initial catch-up curve. Values below 1 help small gaps sooner; values above 1 reserve more XP for large gaps.
CurveExponent.Name: Catch-up curve exponent

DefaultReason.Hint: The default WFRP4e experience-log reason. Supports the compatible %session% and %date% tokens.
DefaultReason.Name: Default award reason

DefaultSelection.Hint: Recipients selected when the console opens without targeted tokens. Explicit targets always replace this default.
DefaultSelection.Name: Default recipients

GapForMaximumAward.Hint: At this gap below the XP leader, the initial catch-up value equals the hard limit before recipient decay.
GapForMaximumAward.Name: Catch-up reference gap

MaximumAward.Hint: The final hard limit in XP. It is applied after recipient decay and the companion multiplier.
MaximumAward.Name: Maximum final award

ScaleExponent.Hint: Controls how quickly catch-up strength falls above the recipient decay start. Zero disables decay.
ScaleExponent.Name: Recipient decay exponent

ScalePivot.Hint: Recipients at or below this total XP keep full catch-up strength. This is evaluated from each recipient, not the XP leader.
ScalePivot.Name: Recipient decay start

UseGmToolkitDefaults.Hint: When WFRP4e GM Toolkit is active, prefer its session, reason, and recipient-group defaults. Disable this to use Drowsy’s WFRP4e Toolkit defaults.
UseGmToolkitDefaults.Name: Prefer compatible GM Toolkit defaults
